subsampling.measure: size-weighted matched cluster Jaccard, noise excluded

graph_checks: Nearest-neighbor and within-cluster shared-exhibition agreement use training facts; not independent predictive evaluation.
supervised_evaluation: Unavailable: external artist reference groups not supplied.
scope: Fixed training-budget comparison with shared preprocessing sensitivity analysis; not exhaustive hyperparameter optimization and not a universal algorithm ranking.
runtime_note: Training durations are wall times under two concurrent CPU training processes; hardware load can affect them.
resource_adjustment: All runs use the same native PyTorch fused Adam implementation, supported by the installed CPU runtime. The original incomplete workers are archived separately.
